scope: approved retrain executor: bounded parameter change evaluated against the original through Persona Teaching, at most one candidate artifact, no deployment

source.delivery_head_binding: The governed handoff freezes the PR head containing this manifest; implementation_commit is its source ancestor.

behavior.persona_source: target registry entry metadata.persona_id; missing -> completed/evaluation_rejected(target_has_no_persona), no session, no mutation
behavior.calls: Registry read -> Training session -> baseline preview job (queue+run+wait) -> existing controls route (one bounded change) -> candidate preview job -> Registry mutate only if proof+gate passed and candidate Sharpe > baseline Sharpe

outcomes.candidate_created: child stays candidate; source_run_ids = decision, session, evaluation proof

behavior.credentials: RESEARCH_REGISTRY_SERVICE_TOKEN (registry-writer, owner-write) and RESEARCH_TRAINING_SERVICE_TOKEN (training-service) issued by scripts/issue_dev_paper_principals.py, mounted read-only via dev-paper-research-tokens, read at call time; research-orchestrator added to TRAINING_SESSION_ALLOWED_CALLER_SERVICES
behavior.training_health: purpose=retrain jobs record under functional operation retrain_evaluation: /readyz stays 200 and the failure stays visible (retrain_evaluation_failures); ordinary refresh rejection still 503

fixes_found_while_testing: Model-bound baseline evaluation failed ('parameter_updates must contain at least one mutation'): services/training-session/main.py::_model_backtest_config now evaluates the original artifact when no control differs from its baseline.
Persona owner 404 was reported as a transport failure: training-session main now reads the Persona owner through a status-preserving transport, so session creation returns 404 'persona not found'.
A dataset not covering the artifact symbols was retried as a dependency outage: it is now a non-retryable evaluation_admission_rejected.

verification.note: real Registry + Training apps over HTTP, strict JWT, issuer tokens, real vectorbt (vbt-real-*), deterministic local dataset; no urlopen/_trigger_retrain_execution patch. Persona owner read API is the only stand-in.
The deselected test fails on the base too: QuantLib is not installed in this environment (503 'QuantLib numerical library is required'); unrelated to this change.

not_verified: No hosted/deployed run: the compose wiring is verified by static tests only; the dev-paper-principals profile has not been re-deployed with the new research-orchestrator-svc volume.
The deselected QuantLib test could not run here.
known_limitation: services/evolution/main.py is outside this task's artifact contract, so the Evolution program-runs listing (and the BFF route over it) carries the retrain outcome in the receipt 'detail' text ('; retrain outcome=... candidate_artifact_id=... session_id=...') rather than as new structured keys. The structured fields (session_id, job/eval ids, baseline_metrics, candidate_metrics, outcome, outcome_reason, candidate_artifact_id) are on GET /api/research-orchestrator/runs/{run_id} and in the receipt evidence. Exposing them as top-level keys on the Evolution items needs a contract amendment (Human/Ops) to touch services/evolution/main.py.
